violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: PIC could not produce his Certified Food Manager certificate.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER IS REQUIRED TO BE PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF FOOD PREPARATION. SEND EHS A COPY OF A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATE BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Paper towels were not provided at the hand sink in the front.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PLACE PAPER TOWELS AT THIS HAND SINK TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed no hand washing sign posted at the hand sink in the back and in the bathroom
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH TWO HAND WASHING SIGN.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Observed a wet cloth being stored on a dish at the espresso machine
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS IN SANITIZER. PIC PUT THE WET CLOTH IN A SANITIZER BUCKET

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Utensils Maintained in Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed the silicon mats heavily scorched and frayed.
violations.corrective_action: Utensils shall be maintained in a state of repair or condition that complies with the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2 or shall be discarded. REPLACE SILICON MATS. PITANGO GELATO (Inspection Date: 02/17/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved Y splitter on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH INFORMATION FOR AN APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE. ORDER AND INSTALL.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Tissue Supplied
violations.observation: No toilet paper was observed in the bathroom
violations.corrective_action: Provide toilet tissue at each toilet to minimize hand contact with fecal waste. PIC REFILLED THE TOILET PAPER.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: plastic to-go container was being stored in the bulk bin of sugar
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED THE PLASTIC TO-GO CONTAINER. SCOOPS WITH HANDLES CAN BE STORED IN THE SUGAR WITH ITS HANDLE STICKING UPWARDS OR OUTSIDE THE CONTAINER.
